results.title: Is NewRelic dying? : r/devops
results.content:
You already copied it. Relic makes sure you never lose it.  
  
Relic keeps a private, encrypted timeline of everything you copy or share to it. Search it in a second, keep the important stuff forever, and pick it up on your computer without anyone else ever seeing a readable byte.  
  
CAPTURE WITHOUT THINKING  
• Share text, links, or images to Relic from any app.  
• Add the Quick Settings tile to capture whatever is on your clipboard in one tap.  
• Or type a note by hand. Codes, addresses, screenshots, that link you'll want next week.  
  
FIND IT IN A SECOND  
• Instant search that tolerates typos. Close enough still finds it.  
• Results learn from you. Things you pick often rank higher, and that ranking is learned and stored on your phone, nowhere else. [...] • Detected passwords, keys, and codes stay masked until you choose to reveal them.  
  
THE VAULT  
The timeline catches everything. The Vault is for the keepers. Tap the gem to save something for good, then add a title, note, or tags. All of it is searchable.  
  
EVERY DEVICE  
• Syncs end-to-end encrypted with the Relic app for Windows and the web vault at relic.space/vault. macOS is on the way.  
• Copy on your PC, find it on your phone. And the other way around.  
• Works offline. Capture and search with no connection, and sync catches up when you're back.  
  
PRIVATE BY MATH, NOT BY POLICY  
• Everything is encrypted on your device with a passphrase only you know.  
• Zero knowledge: the server only ever stores ciphertext. We could not read your history if we wanted to. [...] Copy it once, keep it forever. Private clipboard history, vault, and sync.
